main_text.p: מִפְקָא Ch. Egestio, excrementum, stercus, פִּית מִפְקָּת אֲנָשָׁא Locus egestionis hominum, id est, Latrina, 2. Reg. 10.27. Plur. מִפְקָת מִפְקָן.

ܡܦܩܐ Syr. Prolatio spiritus, h.e. Defensio, Apologia, excusatio: Vide quoque supra in Verbo. Act. 22.1. 2. ad Tim. 4.16. ܒܠܐ ܡܦܩܐ Absq; prolatione spiritus, absque excusatione, id est, inexcusabilis, ad Rom. 1.20. Sic cap. 2.1.
מִפְקָנָא, מִפְקָן Ch. & Syr. Exitus, egressus, progressus. Plur. מִפְקָנֵי מִפְקָנִין.
מַפְקָנוּת Ch. Exitus, egressus, egresio: Prolatio, prolatum, productio.
נפש Ch. Augeri, crescere, in abundantiam erumpere. Ex Aphel Infinit. ad formam Talmudicam לְאַפּוּשִׁי Ad multiplicandum, Job. 38.15. Alii legunt לְאַפּוּשִׁי, quod & ad פּוּשׁ referri posset.
נִפְּשָׁא נִפִּישׁ Ch. Multus, abundans, Deuter. 25.9. Jon.

נִפְשָׁא ܢܦܫܐ ܢܦܫ Ch. & Syr. Anima, animus: Vita, corpus, animatum: ܚܕܐ ܢܦܫܐ Unâ anima, unanimiter, concorditer, Act. 2. v. 46. Deinde ponitur cum Affixis pronominibus, pro Ego ipse, Tu ipsemet, ut Hebraeum אֲנָא נַפְשִׁי עֲצֵם Ego ipse נַפְשֵׁךְ Te-ipsum, &c. Plur. נַפְשַׁת נַפְשָׁתָא, נַפְשִׁין.
נִיפָּשׁ Ch. Spatium, וְנִיפָּשׁ תְּשׁוּן Et spatium ponetis, Genes. 32.16. in Jon.

page.notes: Several Syriac and Hebrew words are reproduced approximately; the scan is small and the vowel points and diacritics are only partly legible. Doubtful Hebrew/Syriac forms should be checked against the original.
